symptom: Right after `marketplace install` of Workflow Commons 4.10.0, `marketplace diff` reported 2 snippets as locally changed on the run that built the reference and 8 on every cached run (all with pluggable widgets: Timeline, Pop-up menu); `update` then refused without --force and --save-edits saved them as edits.
file: cmd/mxcli/marketplace/refcache.go isModelFile (+widgets/) and refEntryFormat f3; cmd/mxcli/marketplace_postinstall.go repairReference; cmd/mxcli/cmd_marketplace_diff.go referenceFor. Tests: cmd/mxcli/marketplace/refcache_widgets_2367_test.go, cmd/mxcli/marketplace_reference_repair_2367_test.go
cause: Two differences between the app and its baseline: (1) the reference cache kept the model and action sources but not widgets/, so a cached reference described pluggable widgets generically (`pluggablewidget '…Timeline' …` with the definition's defaults) while the app described `timeline …`; (2) install runs mx update-widgets / rename-design-properties on the app, never on the reference, so the repair's rewrites of stored props read as edits even on a fresh build.
insight: **A baseline has to go through every step the subject went through, and its cache has to keep every input DESCRIBE reads.** The 2-vs-8 split between the first and cached runs was the tell: two causes, one in the build and one in the cache. Measured on 11.12.6 with Workflow Commons 4.10.0: untouched install → fresh reference 0 changed (was 2), cached 0 (was 8); with one real `alter snippet` edit → exactly that snippet.
